purpose: Cross-module customer pricing schemas and invariants for OPL Workspace charges. Current customer catalog versions, packages, and prices belong only to the versioned Control Plane runtime catalog; provider-cost evidence belongs to Fabric.

lifecycle.removalCondition: Remove only when pricing no longer crosses module boundaries, or replace with a newer current contract for the same pricing schema and accepted-snapshot invariants.

machineBoundary: Customer charges use non-negative integer USD micros from the accepted Control Plane quote. Provider cost evidence and exchange rates never derive, alter, or appear as a customer charge.
rules: Pricing preview and Workspace launch require an available package from live Fabric catalog readback before Gateway, balance, debit, Ledger, or provider calls.
Unknown packages, invalid storage sizes, and unsupported package-storage combinations fail before external side effects.
All components in one accepted Workspace quote use the same priceVersion, currency, and billingUnit.
Provider costs are internal reconciliation evidence and never a customer pricing formula or browser DTO.
